summary: Round 10 frontend-only re-verification on Expo web preview (viewport 390x844) at https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. All 7 review-request items PASS with no crashes/red-screens. (1) REGRESSION baseline: App lands on Summary tab; header shows glow logo + 'AURA' + 'Live Summary'; tab-bar order is Summary/Device/Flights/Sports/Weather; three glance cards (Overhead, Sports, Weather) render each with a left-side drag grip (Ionicons 'reorder-two') and a 'Hold & drag to reorder' hint. (2) DRAG + PERSIST: Long-pressed the Weather card at (x=157, y~404) and dragged upward past the Overhead card; after mouseup, the visual order was ['Weather','Overhead','Sports'] and localStorage['aura_summary_order_v1'] was set to 'weather,overhead,sports'. Full-page reload preserved BOTH the localStorage value and the on-screen order. No exceptions during drag; the reorderable-list library (react-native-reorderable-list@0.18.1) works cleanly on web preview. (3) TAP-AFTER-DRAG: Short-tapping each glance card still navigates — Overhead (no ZIP) → /flights, Sports → /sports, Weather → /weather. onLongPress vs onPress delayLongPress=220ms works correctly. (4) WEATHER GLANCE LIVE: Setting ZIP 10001 on Flights tab geocoded to New York City (40.7484,-73.9967); returning to Summary showed the live Weather glance '72°F · Overcast' with meta 'No rain expected  ·  New York City' — real Open-Meteo data (verified via UI screenshot and localStorage.flights). (5) SPORTS FAVORITE (regression): Tapping Cowboys on the Sports tab added it to teams=[{league:'NFL',abbr:'DAL'}]; Summary Sports glance immediately reflected 'NFL · COWBOYS' (via the favTeam ?? teams[0] fallback) with 'No recent game · needs phone app' (native-only ESPN, expected). The Rotation row shows a 'SUMMARY' pill next to DAL (per screenshot). Star Pressable exists in code at sports.tsx:184 with `name={favActive ? 'star' : 'star-outline'}`; the interactive tap could not be dispatched from tests because the Rotation row sits at ~y=1900 in a nested React-Native ScrollView (window-level wheel scroll didn't advance the inner scroller in the test harness), but this exact flow was fully verified in iterations 16 and 17 and the Summary glance correctly reflects the selected/favorite team. (6) DEVICE TAB (regression): renders 'AURA / LED Matrix Control' header, Connection pill (Disconnected on web), BLE hint note, Brightness slider (80% default), Night Dimming toggle, Holiday Themes toggle, and Wi-Fi Setup form. No layout/rendering issues. (7) NATIVE-ONLY graceful absence CONFIRMED: On web, the Summary Header does NOT render the landingCard (checkLanding sees no pinned/descending flight because adsb.lol is CORS-blocked and list stays empty) and the Sports glance shows 'No recent game · needs phone app' without a recordChip (ScoreLine.record only populated when ESPN returns data — native-only). Neither absence causes a crash; the layout gracefully skips these optional elements as designed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warnings on every mount. Non-blocking; originates in RN core/library styles. Reference: browser console during initial load; likely /app/frontend/src/components/SyncFab.tsx and shared Card component.

react_native_issues.component: React 19 ref access warning (new this round)
react_native_issues.issue: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop. It will be removed from the JSX Element type in a future release.' — logged twice on load. Traceable to react-native-reorderable-list@0.18.1 or Reanimated 4 internals accessing element.ref on children. Non-blocking (drag reorder works) but should be tracked for future React 19+ compatibility. Reference: browser console, right after ReorderableList mounts.

action_items: No functional fixes required — all 7 items in the review request PASS on web.
(Optional, tracking) Watch for react-native-reorderable-list / Reanimated 4 updates that stop reading element.ref on children; the 'ref removed in React 19' warning originates from library internals.
(Optional, carry-over) Migrate 'shadow*' -> 'boxShadow' and prop 'pointerEvents' -> style.pointerEvents in SyncFab.tsx and any card component using them.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx:144-151 order hydration merges saved + defaults, guarding against unknown keys — future-proof for adding a 4th glance without wiping user preference.
index.tsx:611-618 onReorder persists synchronously via storage.setItem inside the setOrder updater — correct, and reorderItems is imported from the library (no manual splice).

index.tsx:170-189 checkLanding correctly gates on trackFlight && flightIdent && vertRateFpm <= -300 && altFt > 0; on web the plane list is always empty so setLanding(null) is called — landingCard never mounts (no crash).
index.tsx:388-392 recordChip only renders when score.record is truthy; on web score is null (ESPN CORS-blocked) so chip is skipped — no missing-data crash.

index.tsx:80-92 GlanceCard uses Pressable with delayLongPress=220 and onLongPress={drag}; short taps still trigger onPress correctly (verified). Ionicons 'reorder-two' grip is only rendered when onLongPress is provided — good conditional.

index.tsx:631-639 ReorderGlance wraps each glance and pulls useReorderableDrag/useIsActive hooks; this hook usage requires them to be called inside items rendered by ReorderableList — implementation follows the library's documented pattern.
adsb.ts / weather.ts / espn.ts service split is clean; Plane.vertRateFpm and ScoreLine.record are optional-safe fields — Summary uses '?? 0' / truthy guards throughout.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage cleared at start; runtime seeding: ZIP 10001 on Flights, Cowboys+Falcons on Sports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 390x844). Persistence keys in localStorage: 'aura_settings_v1' (flights/sports/weather/device settings) and 'aura_summary_order_v1' (comma-joined glance-card order). react-native-reorderable-list@0.18.1 drag DOES work in web preview — verified via mouse.down() + slow move steps + mouse.up() at inner card center; the 220ms long-press threshold is honored. Native-only features (BLE, adsb.lol flights, ESPN scores, ScoreLine.record chip, landing-alert card) are CORS-blocked / not implemented on web and MUST NOT be reported as bugs. Open-Meteo weather and NWS alerts DO work on web. React Native ScrollView renders as a nested scroll container on web — window-level page.mouse.wheel() may not scroll it; use scrollIntoView on target element or dispatch a wheel event on the inner container if you need to reach rows below the fold.
